scope: Small conditional instrument check on four prequalified Latin named entries; does not replace or enlarge the fixed nine Voynich sample.
purpose: Determine what the same four coarse geometric observations can or cannot distinguish on these historical-name examples, with all uncertainty retained. It is not a matched-null test, population sensitivity estimate or semantic decipherment.

nodes.name: cotilidon
nodes.unit_definition: Single central drawing on Bodl.130 f6r: blue-edged central greenish body, its attached lateral stalk/end structures, and attached ochre lower portion. No neighboring principal illustration is included.

feature_definition: Exactly the frozen four main-study geometry definitions and G1 free-terminal ambiguity handling; no redefinition after seeing these drawings.
contrast: For each feature, mean equality on the 2 cross-manuscript same-name pairs minus mean equality on the 2 cross-manuscript different-name pairs; average equally across four features. Report C=C11+C00 with identical weights. The 2 within-manuscript different-name pairs remain descriptive.
blocking_level: One manuscript-pair layer; four different physical leaves. This differs from the three physical-leaf-pair layers of the Voynich experiment and must be labeled explicitly. Never pool the two studies.
uncertainty: Values 0/1/null with allowed singleton or {0,1}; unknown shared for each entry-feature across its incident pairs. Enumerate all admissible global binary states per feature (at most16), sum feature bounds/4. Cartesian relaxation only: conservative outer bounds, not confidence or geometry-sharp intervals.
coding_required: All four named units and all sixteen entry-feature opportunities; no dropping a hard case, substituting K05–K08, merging names or adjusting thresholds.

Use exact pinned original JPEGs and permitted native reading crops. No image generation, enhancement, text removal, segmentation, rotation or rescaling measurements. Display resizing is not native coordinate measurement.

For every value record source image hash, native view and coordinate witnesses, reason, uncertainty and positive evidence or negative full-coverage evidence. G1/G3 ratio thresholds require conservative ranges.
All applicable main-study G1 free-terminal ambiguity cases remain unknown under the same rule; no specially relaxed calibration coding.
Do not calculate any same-name/different-name pair score before the complete observation matrix is frozen.
exposure: Same AI observers know historical names and images; root has seen all four complete pages and native contexts. Source selection used name availability in bounded inventory, not morphology scores, but this is not blinded or representative.
historical_limits: Name readings are qualified informed readings, not critical-edition/expert certification.
Body names and headings differ; four whole-entry illustrations are not four uniform short labels or pharmaceutical fragments.
Two manuscripts share a textual/drawing tradition; copying and conventions are possible. Names do not independently certify modern species.
Positive C would only characterize the four encoded entries; C near zero would not prove that true names lack meaning or that Voynich labels are meaningless.
delivery: known_language_control/observation_v1.json plus brief notes and one evidence/hash receipt, then separate numerical calculation and audit. Main Voynich records unchanged.
